about_the_game: "Cute Star Heroes" is a game inspired by the Klonoa series and 8-bit games on the Nintendo Entertainment System, both in terms of style and sound, designed to fit the limitations of that console. Play as one of the two titular "Cute Star Heroes" — Pami, a brave blue-loving rabbit, or Lumi, a girly pink-loving cat. Travel through eight different worlds and stop Lord Hades from taking control of the universe. The game is designed for both single-player and two-player cooperative modes.

name: Cute Star Heroes Demo
short_description: You help a little star save her world from a terrible demon that attacked their world. You will get into the forest, swim underwater, ride an air surfer, escape from a huge wall with spikes, and also escape from a huge volcano running away from lava.
